sections.heading: Historical match
sections.body: A tournament replay shows the recorded teams, round, match number, outcome, and combat result for a completed tournament match. It does not start a new competitive match or change the recorded bracket.

sections.heading: Playing the replay
sections.body: Choose Play Replay to watch the stored combat sequence. During playback, Skip advances past the animated battle and returns to the replay summary.

sections.heading: Returning
sections.body: Use Back to return to the Colosseum. If replay data cannot be loaded, the error message identifies whether the link is incomplete or the recorded match is unavailable.
